# BizChefs Studio — Comprehensive Documentation & Context Dossier

> Complete factual, operational, and organizational reference document for BizChefs Studio (https://studio.bizchefs.com).

---

## 1. Product Summary & Identity

- **Product Name**: BizChefs Studio
- **Canonical URL**: https://studio.bizchefs.com
- **Parent Organization**: BizChefs (https://bizchefs.com)
- **Product Classification**: Web-based Client Operations Portal & Digital Management Workspace
- **Primary Support & Contact**: https://bizchefs.com/contact
- **Primary Email**: contact@bizchefs.com
- **Target Audience**: Business owners, digital managers, technical leads, and founders partnering with BizChefs for custom web engineering, hosting, and ongoing digital care.

---

## 2. Platform Purpose & Problem Solved

Modern businesses frequently manage multiple fragmented services across separate third-party platforms:
- Domain registrars for DNS records and renewal notices
- Cloud hosting control panels for server status, backups, and storage
- Source control pipelines for deployment logs and commit tracking
- Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console for performance oversight
- Email and messaging threads for maintenance requests and ticketing

BizChefs Studio centralizes these operational touchpoints into a unified, secure portal. Clients gain real-time visibility into their digital properties without needing direct administrative access to underlying hosting infrastructure or raw server credentials.

---

## 3. Core Functional Capabilities

### 3.1 Website & Infrastructure Oversight
- Real-time operational status (Active, Maintenance, Building)
- SSL certificate validation (TLS 1.3 / Let's Encrypt)
- Datacenter location tracking (Cloud Infrastructure)
- Storage utilization and uptime monitoring
- Active Care Plan assignment and SLA tracking

### 3.2 Domain & DNS Management
- Centralized domain portfolio overview
- Auto-renewal status and expiration date tracking
- DNS zone records count and nameserver configuration
- Record inspection (A, CNAME, MX, TXT records)

### 3.3 Deployments & Pipeline Monitoring
- Automated build and deployment logs
- Git branch and commit reference tracking
- Build duration and completion timestamps
- Deployment status verification (Success, In-Progress, Failed)

### 3.4 Connected Analytics
- Google Analytics 4 Data API integration: 30-day active users, page views, growth metrics, and acquisition channels
- Google Search Console integration: organic search clicks, impressions, average CTR, and average ranking positions
- Encrypted credential handling for connected third-party integrations

### 3.5 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
The platform enforces a structured role-based access model:
- **Superadmin**: Full administrative oversight across client workspaces and user management.
- **Admin**: Operational management within assigned client workspaces.
- **Tech**: Technical runtime access, deployment monitoring, and infrastructure logs within assigned workspaces.
- **Owner**: Business oversight, performance metrics, and service requests isolated strictly to the client organization.

### 3.6 Support & Care Plan Services
- Ticket creation, status updates, and threaded communication
- Direct coordination with BizChefs engineering and maintenance leads
- Integration with ongoing monthly care plans

---

## 4. Platform Architecture & Security Overview

- **Application Architecture**: Modern web application built with responsive layout components, modular navigation, and accessibility standards.
- **Workspace Security**: Strict client workspace isolation ensuring organizations only access their authorized resources and data.
- **Session Protection**: Authenticated client sessions with secure credential handling and role-based permissions.
- **Integration Protection**: Encrypted token and credential handling for third-party reporting services.
- **Search & Discovery Directives**: Indexable public landing page with canonical URL declarations, coupled with noindex directives on private workspace routes.
